findings.impact: Prevents an English-only surface PASS. The defect is language leakage, not a clipping or mathematical-layout failure.

limits: This is an independent bounded offline review of precisely the eight selected modern-us-neutral-en text screenshots, opened once each. No Chinese-edition, original source, figure, written-exercise, supplementary, or cropped images were opened.

The PNGs are full-page captures at recorded desktop 1440x960 and mobile 390x844 viewports; their image heights exceed viewport height. Visible last-page content is not a claim that all content fits in the first viewport.
Existing headless isolated HTML/DOM evidence was read, not rerun. No headed product, interactive navigation, live app font loading, database state, or production rendering was verified.
Hash agreement binds this review to the saved files; it does not independently establish how or when the earlier capture was produced.

Recorded geometry covers top-level boxes, not every glyph or nested mathematical span. Visual review found no clipping, but this is not a fresh per-glyph collision, computed-font-size, or minimum-text-pixel audit.

Source-block counts in the manifest were not compared against original pages. Translation correctness, physical correctness, source fidelity, and missing-source-content coverage are outside this visual-only scope.
The visible modern n114 reduced-constant glyph cannot resolve the pre-existing source typography HOLD.
The Exercises 7 link on n110 was only observed; the seven exercises and link behavior were not reviewed.
No repair or acceptance rerender was performed. Product acceptance and promotion remain false regardless of the layout observations.
